Features

Everything You Need to Run Your Business

From inventory to invoicing, expense tracking to business reports — we've got every tool your business needs.

Real-time Dashboard

KPIs, cashflow charts, reminders, and business health — everything at a glance.

Smart Inventory

Track items with categories, units, barcode support, and CSV import.

Sales Management

Create invoices, record payments, manage quotations and returns.

Purchase Tracking

Purchase invoices, payment-out, and return management in one place.

Customer & Supplier Ledger

Complete party management with transaction history and balances.

Business Analytics

Profit & loss, cashflow, transaction reports, and data exports.

Expense Management

Track every expense with categories, dates, and receipt records.

Staff & Permissions

Role-based access control so each team member sees only what they need.

How It Works

Up and Running in 3 Minutes

Getting started is as simple as 1-2-3. No complex setup, no training needed.

1

Sign Up in Seconds

Create your account with your phone number and password, then use QR login from the mobile app whenever you need web access.

2

Set Up Your Business

Add your business details, import existing data via CSV, invite your team, and configure your preferences.

3

Start Managing

Create invoices, track inventory, manage expenses, and watch your business grow with real-time insights.

Deep Dive

Powerful Tools for Every Need

Explore how each feature helps you run your business more efficiently.

Sales & Invoicing

Create professional invoices in seconds. Track payments, manage returns, and never miss a due date.

  • Create and send invoices instantly
  • Track payment-in and outstanding balances
  • Manage sales returns with full traceability
  • Create quotations and convert to invoices
  • Due date reminders and notifications

Your Business in Your Pocket

QR Code Login

No typing passwords on shared devices. Scan the QR code on the login page from your phone and you're in instantly.

Fully Responsive

Every feature works beautifully on mobile browsers. Create invoices, check reports, and manage inventory on the go.
